Press “L” to quickly select the line tool to draw a line. Also, hovering over objects will reveal connection points if you want to draw lines between two objects.
Quickly add an adjacent object that is connected to the one you’ve selected by clicking on the + icon in the desired direction.
Add text to your connections. Select the +T button on the connector menu to add in text. Once made, you can move the placement of your label.
